-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect()
e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS) e:SetLabel(0)
e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg) return e:GetLabel()==0 and eg:IsExists(function(c) return c:IsControler(1) and c:IsFaceup() end,1,nil) end)
e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg) local g=eg:Filter(function(c) return c:IsControler(1) and c:IsFaceup() end,nil) local c=g:GetFirst() if c then e:SetLabel(1) local token=Duel.CreateToken(0,c:GetOriginalCode()) Duel.SendtoHand(token,0,REASON_EFFECT) end end)
Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
